ios.desc:
QuitKit is your personal toolkit to quit smoking, alcohol, cannabis, and gambling — for good.

Whether you're on day one or day one hundred, QuitKit gives you the structure, accountability, and community you need to stay on track. No lectures. No shame. Just real tools that work.

HOW IT WORKS

Pick your habit — smoking, alcohol, cannabis, or gambling — and make it official. QuitKit walks you through a personal quit journey from day one.

SEAL IT WITH YOUR VOICE

Record a Quit Contract out loud. QuitKit listens, verifies your words, and seals your commitment. It's not just a tap on a button — it's a pledge you hear in your own voice. Come back and replay it whenever you need a reminder of why you started.

WATCH YOUR BODY HEAL

Your body starts recovering within hours of quitting. QuitKit shows you exactly what's happening — from easier breathing at 72 hours to improved circulation at 2 weeks and beyond. Every milestone is a reason to keep going.

SEE THE MONEY YOU'RE SAVING

Enter what you used to spend and watch the savings add up in real time. Collect your daily savings as a visual reward. It's surprising how fast it grows — and incredibly motivating.

YOU'RE NOT DOING THIS ALONE

Join Support Clubs to chat with others who are quitting the same habit. Share what you're going through, ask questions, and get honest answers from people who truly understand.

Connect with Sponsors - members who check in on your progress and offer support when cravings hit. A simple "How are you doing?" from someone who's been there can make all the difference.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

• Quit smoking, alcohol, cannabis & gambling — one app
• Voice-recorded Quit Contract you can replay anytime
• Recovery timeline with real health milestones
• Savings tracker with daily collection
• Community Clubs for peer support
• Sponsor check-ins and encouragement
• Available in multiple languages
• Clean, distraction-free design

YOUR QUIT, YOUR WAY

QuitKit doesn't tell you how to feel or flood you with notifications. It gives you honest tracking, real community, and a pledge in your own voice. The rest is up to you - and you're more ready than you think.

SUBSCRIPTION

QuitKit offers a subscription that unlocks the full experience including community features, sponsor connections, and unlimited access to all tools. quotes.text:
I quit a few years ago and never looked back, even made a pet app for quitting smoking as I was learning iOS development. Check it out, recently switched from UIKit to SwiftUI: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1459979131

When I was quitting smoking I found 2 things useful:

1) Alan Carr's book, which in essence is designed to convince you that you actually don't enjoy smoking. I completely agree, when I first started it gave me the sensation, then I had to smoke every half an hour just to stay functional.

2) The cigarette prices. There was no way I can sustain smoking when first move to London. A pack of cigarettes was the same as my food budged.

So, I just quit as a chain smoker. It was bad for a week but I kept observing myself and surely Alan Carr was right. I wasn't getting any boost from the nicotine, I was simply getting rid of the cravings for a brief period of time. In a month all the cravings disappears, in less than a year I had no desire to smoke even among people who are smoking. These days the cigarette smoke is simply something I try to avoid when exposed.

This was not my first time to quit but on the previous occasions I had the wrong mental model. I was thinking of it as stopping doing something that I enjoy, like quitting chocolates. In less than a day it would have turned into torture.

Just observe yourself to see if smoking actually gives you any pleasure or does smoking simply make you functional again. Then remember that non-smokers are functional …
